blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:

blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: Run the recommission tests to ensure the oven is functioning correctly and the touch screen is working.

blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: Microwave emissions are below the permissible limit of 5mW/cm², ideally <1mW/cm 2 .

blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: The power output of the oven is checked in accordance with the procedure.

blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: Earth leakage is within permissible limits.

blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: The oven has a correct air gap of 50 mm / 2 inches above. Air flow should not be restricted at the front, top or rear of the oven.

blocks.section: Before finishing a service call, recheck the following points:
blocks.content: Complete the service report.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: All internal electrical connections are correct (see "Electrical circuit diagrams" in section 7).

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: All wiring insulation is correct and is not touching any sharp edges.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: All grounding connections are electrically and mechanically secure.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: Any removed heat tape or cable ties are refitted/replaced.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: All door safety interlocks are secure and mechanically sound.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: The door activates all the door interlock switches and in the correct order.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: The door operation is smooth.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: The door seal is in good condition and seals against the cavity.

blocks.section: Complete the following checks after the oven has been serviced/repaired/tested before connecting to the mains electricity power supply:
blocks.content: The casing is securely refitted with no trapped wires and all the fixing bolts are refitted.

blocks.section: Service Settings : Temperature Calibration Check / Recalibration
blocks.content: Service Settings : Temperature Calibration Check / Recalibration

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Tools required:

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: 1 x Calibrated digital thermometer

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: 1 x Temperature probe on a heat sink

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Place temperature probe in the centre of cavity

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Ensure the oven is in 'Full Serve Mode'

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Select  250 o C  oven  temperature.  If  there  is  no  preheat  temp  programmed  appropriate  for  the  oven  test,  a  new temperature must be programmed into a spare location (250°C).

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Wait for the oven to reach the preheat temperature of 250 o C.

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Once the preheat temperature has been achieved, press the chef's hat 'recipe creation' on the easy-touch screen.

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Select 10 minutes run time, 100% convection fan and 0% microwave.

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Press the play button at the bottom of the screen

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: When the timer has 30 seconds remaining press the temp icon the temperature the oven sensor thinks the cavity has reached will be displayed prefixed with *

blocks.section: Tools required:
blocks.content: Compare the displayed temperature with the actual temperature shown on the digital thermometer. Recalibration will be required, and should be carried out swiftly, if the readings are outside the following guidelines;
